name: Upgrade a Lucky Block!
desc:
Welcome to Upgrade a Lucky Block! 🌟

How far can you UPGRADE you Blocks? Keep Upgrading to get the Biggest Lucky Blocks! 🤯

1. Pick up a Lucky Block from your Conveyor 🏭
2. Upgrade your Blocks! ⭐
3. Open the Block to get a Brainrot! 🕵️
4. Put the Brainrot on your base to earn money 💵

🧠 Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

👍 Like the game & join the group!
